test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'ANSWER' is written as 'ASNEWR', and 'BRANCH' is written as 'BARCNH'. How will 'LAWYER' be written in that language?
solution:
The logic follows here is :-

'ANSWER' is written as 'ASNEWR'.

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/033ef1cfeed1418f1dc9c0c997637f70e822328c5e5b368f0ec0d37e189b90f8.png] 

And

'BRANCH' is written as 'BARCNH'.

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/33c800f2adf7135ec3f9453f61af536d23e9406bdaa8fb2769ae84487a2358b7.png] 

Similarly,

'LAWYER' will be written as :

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/38f43745b4f1f7fe9685af360b04004c9c0f94e59288b72f1aa25b55acbc48fd.png] 

**Hence, the correct answer is "LWAEYR".**
